svg.title: Search walks a graph of neighbors.

g.text: Search walks a graph of neighbors.
Graph engines link each vector to a few near ones and answer a query by walking toward it.
THE SAME THREE FLAGS, IN EACH ENGINE'S WORDS
HNSW engines grow a layered graph one insert at a time;
CAGRA prunes a k-NN graph to a fixed degree on the GPU,
so its names match the flags by role, not by algorithm.
Thick path: the walk from the entry point. Rings: neighbors scored on the way. Dashed: a vector being linked in.
